versions.changelog:
- Initial release of lobster-zhouyi skill.
- Features a scholarly lobster character specializing in Zhouyi and traditional fate studies.
- Provides daily knowledge points at 19:00 (Beijing time) with academic, non-superstitious cultural interpretations.
